_purpose: First-run guided tour steps (infinite-of-x: was hardcoded in web/shared/onboarding-tour.js). target is a CSS selector to highlight (null = centered welcome card). Edit here; the tour fetches this file. Native has no tour yet; if one is added it should read this same file.

steps.title: Welcome to HumanityOS!
steps.text: A cooperative platform to end poverty and unite humanity. Let's show you around.

steps.title: Network
steps.text: Chat with others, join voice channels, and send encrypted DMs.

steps.title: Tasks
steps.text: Track projects with the kanban board. Create tasks, assign them, and organize by project.

steps.title: Marketplace
steps.text: Buy, sell, and trade with other members. Zero middleman fees.

steps.title: Wallet
steps.text: Your identity IS your wallet. Send, receive, and manage crypto.

steps.title: Settings
steps.text: Customize your experience, manage your identity, and configure notifications.

steps.title: You're all set!
steps.text: Start by chatting in the Network tab, or explore at your own pace. Your identity is secured with post-quantum cryptography, back up your seed phrase in Settings!
